description: Top holders of token X. Returns the largest wallet holders of a token (owner address, token amount, and share of supply) by contract address. Example: birdeye_token_holders({ address: "So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112", limit: 20, chain: "solana", _apiKey: "your-key" })

_apiKey.description: Birdeye API key (get one at birdeye.so; limited free tier).

chain.description: Blockchain to query (sent as the x-chain header). Defaults to "solana".

limit.description: Number of top holders to return (1–50, default 50).

name: birdeye_token_holders
title: Birdeye Token Holders
